summary: P01 VF News: 旧私人 RSS 缓存与新抓取的可见摘要剔除外部裸 URL、链接包裹与导航套话，保留真正作者说明；默认未读流跳过仅链接条目，全部文章/来源/搜索及私有身份、已读状态保持。仅 presentation 与派生识别修复，未改 Schema/Auth/Updater/Provider；此前机器 #42830094762、#42831523854 成功，正式 Release workflow 须在合并 main 精确源码重新验证 FULL/Atomic/数据保持/回滚/远端资产 SHA。Owner 已授权 2.47.515 发布，Production 仍仅 Owner 手动备份与升级。 Scoped contract reconciliation: owner-approved 2026-11-10 independent subsite UX supersedes stale UX-53 test literal; #1966 updates only one test to assert old Wide Desktop CSS remains while new Owner PROTO-01 UX-53 authority is enforced. No production runtime file changed by reconciliation. Prior formal release gate #42842053268 failed only at stale wide-layout docs literal and published no assets; this request requires full exact-source re-verification.
